sources.summary: The conversion of a Victorian hospital is one of three reuse projects that make up the shortlist for the 2026 RIAS Andrew Doolan Best Building in Scotland award. Designed by Bennetts Associates, the former hospital building now houses a mix of teaching spaces for the University of Edinburgh, including a 450-seat auditorium.
